contract.withings_access_token: withings_access_token(data_dir: Path) -> str | None. None iff neither secrets/withings_oauth.json (seed, read-only) nor data_dir/withings_oauth.json (live) exists; selection by secrets_paths.oauth_token_source. Under flock data_dir/.withings_oauth.lock: unreadable/invalid credential raises; expiry within 60 s refreshes via POST action=requesttoken grant_type=refresh_token with client files secrets/withings_client_id and withings_client_secret; the NEW access+refresh token is persisted to data_dir/withings_oauth.json (0600, same-dir temp, fsync, atomic replace, dir fsync) BEFORE the access token is returned, because Withings rotates the refresh token on every refresh.
contract.fetch_bp: fetch_bp(access_token: str, lastupdate: int) -> list[dict]. POST /measure action=getmeas meastypes=10,9,11 category=1 lastupdate. Each measure value = value * 10**unit. A group yields a row only if it has both systolic (10) and diastolic (9): {ts: int unix, systolic, diastolic, pulse|None, grpid}. Follows more/offset until more is falsy; more=1 without a new offset raises instead of looping.
contract.authorize: authorize(seed_path: Path) -> None. One-time on a machine with a browser: prints authorize URL (scope user.metrics, redirect http://localhost:9877/withings/callback, random state), serves exactly one request on 127.0.0.1:9877, accepts only matching path, one matching state and one code, exchanges immediately (the code lives 30 s), stores token to seed_path 0600. Never logs or prints the code or tokens. Script entry: argv[1] or secrets_dir()/withings_oauth.json; errors exit 1. The receiver binds 127.0.0.1 by default; WITHINGS_CALLBACK_BIND=0.0.0.0 makes it reachable through a port published on the host's localhost (docker compose run -p 127.0.0.1:9877:9877).
contract._post (shared rule): Withings answers HTTP 200 even on errors; body status != 0 raises WithingsError. HTTPError/network/JSON errors raise without provider body. All failures raise WithingsError: RuntimeError subclass for any Withings or local credential failure. Message never contains tokens, authorization codes, client secret or provider body.
contract.limits: Measure type codes 9/10/11 are from Withings documentation; confirmed against the owner's live answer at first import (lesson C-28). Callback on localhost must be accepted by the Withings developer dashboard; if not, the redirect changes, not the flow. No webhook: import polls twice a day (Withings asks not more often than every 10 min). A lost response after server-side rotation cannot be recovered locally: the next refresh fails loudly and the owner re-authorizes.

items.D1: One responsibility: Withings credentials and blood-pressure measures over HTTP; no database, no scheduling, no UI.
items.D3: Only secrets_paths and _time_inject public functions plus stdlib.
items.D4: About 200 lines in one file; contract plus tests are enough to rewrite it.
items.D5: tests/unit/test_withings_bp.py executes withings_access_token (absent, fresh, rotating), fetch_bp (units, non-BP group, paging, stuck paging) and the status-in-body rule; mutations 'trust HTTP 200' and 'do not save the new token' each turn one test red (04.10).
items.D6: Seed/live file names and order follow secrets_paths.oauth_token_source like Oura; the storage of readings and the sensor live outside (import_withings, integrity_tests).

disposability.rationale: Small HTTP client behind an executable contract; replacing it means rewriting one file against the same tests.
